Bihar Deepotsav: munger jile ke bariyarpur prakhand antargat kalyanpur men shanivar ko bihar ke sabse bare dipotsav ka bhavy aayojan kiya gaya. is aitihasik aayojan men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri shamil hue. unhonne shrishri 108 bari durga maharani ke prangan men dip prajvalit kar karyakram ka shubharanbh kiya. is mauke par pura parisar lakhon dipon ki roshni se jagamga utha.
